title: Building a Russian-language educational platformer for kids with ChatGPT/Codex — mobile gameplay and feedback welcome
author: Top-Experience4408
selftext:
I’m the project initiator behind “Sonic Adventures,” a small educational game for children aged 6–9. The idea is mine; ChatGPT/Codex helped implement and revise the game.

The character is an original turquoise robot named Sonic, not SEGA’s character.

We started with an earlier version, then rebuilt it as a 2D platform adventure. The current game has five worlds and 15 activities covering files and folders, command sequences, typing, digital safety, and drawing.

My role has been choosing the direction, requesting changes, and testing on an Android phone. The AI-assisted work included the game code, browser version, offline support, and Android packaging. The attached video shows actual mobile gameplay.

The game is currently in Russian only. It is free to play, with no account or ads. The browser version works offline after its first successful load and the offline-ready confirmation.

I’d appreciate feedback on the touch controls and the balance between platforming and learning activities. Does jumping feel approachable for younger players? Would you simplify the movement before adding more content?

I’m also interested in how other AI-assisted developers check that an educational game is understandable to its intended age group.

Playable browser version:
[https://elkin-oskol.github.io/-\_-/](https://elkin-oskol.github.io/-_-/)

Project idea and brand: Ёлкин/О́скол.

comments.author: Top-Experience4408
comments.body:
В игре пять миров и 15 заданий: файлы, маршруты, текст, безопасность и рисование.

Если попробуете с ребёнком, расскажите: сколько ему лет, удобно ли управление и какое задание вызвало трудности. Без имён, фото и других личных данных детей.
